blocks.text: How and when do you know that your partner is the right one? Is it when they know everything about you? When they have the financial means to provide for you? Or is it when they’ve shown that they’re ready to build a life with you? Well, this TikTok trend might just help you figure it out. ‘Stop the Wedding,’ the latest single of American singer-songwriter Ashe, has recently been the soundtrack of social media platforms, especially TikTok, after it is being used to warn people of the signs when to rethink their decisions to marry and settle with their partners.
